subject: Web Development
title: Interaction to Next Paint
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Interaction to Next Paint.

hook.text: A page can load fast but feel sluggish when you try to interact with it.

buildup.text: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) measures the delay between a click and the visual response.

discovery.text: Good INP is under 200 milliseconds. Slower means the page feels unresponsive to touch.

twist.text: INP replaced First Input Delay in 2024 because it measures all interactions, not just the first.

climax.text: INP captures what users actually feel — whether the page responds when they act.

punchline.text: Responsiveness is the metric users feel most.

quiz.question: What replaced First Input Delay as a Core Web Vital?
